mapper.select:
select from (select id, name, phone_number, nick_name, avatar, last_login_time, last_login_ip, is_deleted, create_time from employee limit #{limit} offset #{offset} ) e left join employee_role er on e.id=er.employee_id and er.is_deleted=0
e.is_deleted=0
and (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pageRequest.keyword}, '%') or nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pageRequest.keyword}, '%'))
order by e.create_time

select , p.permission_code from employee e inner join employee_role er on e.id=er.employee_id and er.employee_Id = #{employeeId} and e.is_deleted=0 and er.is_deleted=0 inner join role_permission rp on er.role_id=rp.role_id and rp.is_deleted=0 inner join permission p on p.id=rp.permission_id and p.is_deleted=0 order by e.create_time

select p.permission_alias from employee e inner join employee_role er on e.id=er.employee_id and er.employee_Id = #{employeeId} and e.is_deleted=0 and er.is_deleted=0 inner join role_permission rp on er.role_id=rp.role_id and rp.is_deleted=0 inner join permission p on p.id=rp.permission_id and p.permission_type=2 and p.is_deleted=0 order by e.create_time
